title: Lockstep capture of a machine run
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $i$ be one of its work-tape indices, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. If $M$'s run from $c$ is not halted at any time $s<t$, then after $t$ steps the capture machine started from the embedding of $c$ has exactly the configuration obtained by embedding the configuration of $M$ after $t$ steps from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
For every natural number $s<t$, the run from $c$ is not halted at time $s$
replaced:
If the base machine remains live at every time strictly below $t$, then $t$
steps of the capture wrapper from an embedded configuration equal the
embedding of $t$ steps of the base machine.
